dog.description_text: Meet Choco — New Arrival! Choco just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FChoco%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQp9xmnV7sM0TqSHiATQnttMEgUDiITWIXWAxiN7cyA7vjTn7A His foster says, "Choco is a sweet, shy boy. He took a couple of days to feel comfortable, but now he's gotten settled into a nice routine! He prefers to stay cozy in a cat bed during the day, and I catch him sitting on the window sill every so often. While he is typically reserved, Choco surprises me all the time with different aspects of his personality. I recently discovered he loves to play with any kind of string-on-stick toy, and he also LOVES to be scratched behind the ears. He also does not mind being held, especially if paired with a scratch behind the ears!! I am so curious to see how he will continue to blossom with more stability and comfort." He has been neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
